# Priory Medical Journals

> > Priory Medical Journals is a comprehensive online platform hosting peer-reviewed medical and clinical journals across multiple specialties, pioneering digital medical publishing since 1994.

Priory Medical Journals operates as a leading digital publisher of peer-reviewed medical research across diverse clinical specialties including psychiatry, surgery, dentistry, pharmacy, and veterinary medicine. The platform serves as a central repository for clinical research, case reports, and evidence-based medical knowledge, with established author guidelines and submission standards.

## Key Topics

## Medical Specialty Journals

- [Psychiatry OnLine](https://www.priory.com/psych.htm): World's first online medical journal since 1994, peer-reviewed psychiatric research
- [Medicine Online](https://www.priory.com/med.htm): Peer-reviewed journal covering cardiology, endocrinology, and infectious disease
- [Surgery Online](https://www.priory.com/surgery/surg.htm): Journal for surgical research, case reports, and clinical surgical procedures
- [Chest Medicine Online](https://www.priory.com/chest.htm): Respiratory medicine journal covering pulmonary conditions and tuberculosis
- [Dentistry Online](https://www.priory.com/dent.htm): World's first dental journal online, peer-reviewed dental research forum
- [Pharmacy Online](https://www.priory.com/pharmol.htm): Peer-reviewed journal for pharmaceutical research and drug development
- [Anaesthesia Online](https://www.priory.com/anaes.htm): Journal covering anesthesia research, pain management, and surgical procedures
- [Vet Online](https://www.priory.com/vet.htm): International journal covering veterinary medicine and animal health
- [Family Medical Practice Online](https://www.priory.com/fam.htm): Journal for primary care and general practice clinical research
- [History of Medicine Online](https://www.priory.com/homol.htm): Journal exploring medical history and evolution of clinical specialties
